contract: Compare configuration events in delivery order and the active state on every packet, per track, through the typed reader.

State rows give presence, payload bytes, and known source, header offset, payload offset, length and Segment Position. The oracle applies CodecState before the affected block, including every lace, including a state larger than the structural metadata budget.
FFmpeg exposes no CodecState update on packets or their streams.
